tailoring.headline: Senior Java Developer | Spring Boot, REST APIs & Microservices | E-Commerce Platforms
tailoring.summary: Backend developer with 5+ years of professional experience building, extending and supporting large enterprise e-commerce platforms and modernizing legacy architectures using Java, Spring Boot, RESTful APIs and microservices for Rockwell Automation and Shell. Strong in database performance tuning, CI/CD pipelines, cloud deployments and agile teams. SAP Certified Commerce Cloud Developer.

APIs & Integration: PIM / ERP / MDM integration (Profisee, SAP ERP)

cover_en.subject: Application: [Post]
cover_en.hook: I am writing to express my strong interest in modernizing legacy capabilities into robust Java and Spring Boot microservices. With over 5 years of backend engineering experience building enterprise e-commerce platforms at Rockwell Automation and Shell, I bring deep expertise in scalable system design, REST APIs, and core platform migrations.

bullets.label: Java and Spring Boot Engineering
bullets.text: Designed and implemented robust backend functionality using Java and Spring Boot across enterprise platforms, adhering to best practices, design patterns, and clean architecture standards.

bullets.label: REST APIs and Integration Modernization
bullets.text: Engineered and exposed RESTful APIs, OCC web services, and data pipelines to decouple frontend architectures and streamline third-party integrations with enterprise ERP and MDM systems.

bullets.label: Performance Optimization
bullets.text: Led database query refactoring, index tuning, and backend optimizations that significantly reduced response latency and improved overall transaction throughput in production.

bullets.label: Agile Delivery & Technical Leadership
bullets.text: Executed CI/CD deployment cycles in cloud environments, performed rigorous code reviews, and collaborated closely with international stakeholders to deliver complex migration initiatives.

cover_en.logistics: I am based in Karlsruhe with a valid German residence and work permit. I am currently serving my notice period with a last working day of 15.12.2026, making me available to start from 16.12.2026. I would welcome the opportunity to discuss how my Java and microservices expertise aligns with your modernization goals.

tailoring.why_company: I am eager to contribute to your technical modernization initiatives, leveraging my extensive background in Java, Spring Boot, and enterprise backend engineering to transition legacy platforms into scalable microservices architectures.
tailoring.motivation_short: I bring 5+ years of backend engineering experience in Java, Spring Boot, and scalable platform modernization to your team.
tailoring.linkedin_message: Dear Rishi, your initiative to modernize legacy capabilities into Java/Spring Boot microservices aligns perfectly with my 5+ years of backend engineering experience at Rockwell Automation and Shell. I'd love to connect and discuss how my expertise can support your team.
tailoring.email_body:
Dear Hiring Team,

I am writing to apply for the [Post] position. With over 5 years of professional backend engineering experience specialising in Java, Spring Boot, REST APIs, and microservices architecture at Rockwell Automation and Shell, I am well-equipped to drive your platform modernization initiatives.

Please find my CV and cover letter attached. I am based in Karlsruhe with a valid work permit and am available to start from 16.12.2026.

Best regards,
Kranti Chavan
